title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Claims Manual: Coverage, Settlement and Payment of Certificate Claims
content:
**Coverage period.** A claim under a **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** certificate is covered only when the date of loss falls on or after the certificate's coverage effective date and before its expiration or cancellation effective date.

**Service.** The adjuster contacts the borrower within 48 elapsed hours, and the proof of loss is due within 60 calendar days of the date of loss.

**Settlement.** The building loss is taken at the tier's building settlement basis (replacement cost on Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Replacement Cost, actual cash value on every other tier) and the contents loss at actual cash value. Each coverage bears its own deductible (the tier's building and contents deductibles) and is capped at the certificate limit. The payable amount of a coverage is the loss on its basis less its deductible, never below zero, and no more than the certificate limit for that coverage. Increased Cost of Compliance, loss of use and basement contents are covered only as the tier allows; no tier includes them.

**Payment.** A new payment on a coverage is the payable amount less what has been paid net of voids on that claim and coverage, issued only when positive, payable to the lender and the borrower jointly, and due within 30 calendar days of the agreed proof of loss.

**Denial.** A denial states one reason: not a flood event; no coverage on the date of loss; proof of loss not timely; excluded property; or loss below deductible.

## Hypothetical worked example (actual cash value tier)

Hypothetical inputs: building loss at actual cash value 18,400 dollars; deductible 1,000 dollars; certificate building limit 12,000 dollars; already paid on this claim and coverage, net of voids, 9,000 dollars.
- Loss less deductible: 17,400 dollars; capped at the limit: 12,000 dollars payable.
- New payment: 12,000 dollars less 9,000 dollars, that is 3,000 dollars, issued to the lender and the borrower jointly.

| Date of loss relative to the certificate | Covered? |
|---|---|
| Before the coverage effective date | No |
| On the coverage effective date | Yes |
| On the expiration or cancellation effective date | No |
